limitations: Model-estimated capacity PROXY, not facility AAR: no independent facility AAR label exists for validation.
Population is BTS reporting carriers only; no scaling to whole-airport rates (cargo, GA, military and most international flights are excluded).
Throughput in high-demand hours is assumed informative about attainable rates; low demand, flow programmes and coverage limits mean the frontier can understate physical capacity.
Validation compares the frozen frontier to observed high-demand throughput, a proxy target - not AAR accuracy.
population: BTS On-Time Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance: domestic scheduled flights of reporting carriers; excludes non-reporting airlines, cargo, general aviation, military and most international flights

demand_screen.deduplication: one row per (airport, target hour) before thresholds

method.name: high_demand_weather_frontier_v1
method.cells: lead-specific (airport, horizon, regime); leads are never pooled

runway_assumption: crosswind/tailwind from weather_features, computed against fixed challenge headings ATL 080 / DFW 180
scaling: none: no division by sample fraction, no whole-airport extrapolation
